Definition: Return on equity (net income / book equity)
Cash-based operating profitability ((EBITDA + R&D expense − operating accruals) / assets)
Quarterly return on equity (quarterly net income / lagged book equity)
Operating cash-flow profitability (operating cash flow / assets)
Price-to-52-week-high ratio (price / highest price over 252 trading days)
Free-cash-flow yield (free cash flow / market equity)
